name: in war
description: 1 = open armed conflict between the two states at any time during the year, declared or not (e.g. Russia-Ukraine from 2014).

name: neighbours
description: 1 = the two states share a land border in that year.

name: in war crisis
description: 1 = a war crisis between the two states at any time during the year: a lighter form of war short of open war (armed incidents, border clashes, mobilisation against each other, ultimatums, fighting through proxies); open war is 'in war'.
